us_election.reading: consolidation — AI held as a strategic asset, access to allies rationed from Washington

events.title: Labour Displacement Wave
events.description: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced. The numbers are argued about; the absence of hiring is not.

events.title: Coercion Over ASML
events.description: Washington forces the Netherlands to cut ASML's exports and servicing further still – beyond the leading-edge machines to the older lithography equipment China uses for ordinary chips, and in the harder versions to a widening list of other customers. The instrument is jurisdiction over American technology in the supply chain, and refusing it is not obviously survivable for the company. The Union's one chokepoint is being used, and not by the Union.

portfolio.name: InvestAI Gigafactories
portfolio.description: €200bn fund for four to five sites`` — finished this turn

portfolio.name: Tech sovereignty package
portfolio.description: Targets €200bn of private capital for AI data centres by 2036 and proposes accelerated-permitting zones`` — finished this turn

portfolio.name: Establish the European AI Assurance Directorate (EAAD)
portfolio.description: A new public agency to conduct independent pre-deployment evaluations of frontier models and audit safety claims with legal authority to delay releases`` — finished this turn

portfolio.name: Critical Infrastructure Resilience Surge (CIRS)
portfolio.description: A rapid, targeted hardening of energy, water, and transport control systems against AI-powered intrusion, with mandatory detection upgrades and cross-border red-teaming exercises`` — finished this turn

portfolio.name: Launch the Sovereign AI Core Programme (SACP)
portfolio.description: Establish a publicly governed, EU-operated AI development and deployment stack — from training infrastructure to agent deployment — capable of reaching 60.0 by turn 8, with full weight control and auditability`` — finished this turn

portfolio.name: Establish the Sovereign Model Assurance Framework (SMAF)
portfolio.description: A binding technical and legal regime requiring all models trained or operated under the Sovereign AI Core Programme to be fully auditable, weight-secure, and operationally isolated from external infrastructure`` — finished this turn

portfolio.name: Launch the Public Assurance Protocol
portfolio.description: A binding requirement that all sovereign AI systems above 55.0 capability subject to SMAF or the AI Containment Protocol must publish an annual public assurance report, co-signed by the EAAD and national oversight bodies, explaining their safety architecture, containment measures, and incident history in accessible language`` — finished this turn

portfolio.name: Launch the Openweight Containment Initiative
portfolio.description: A binding directive requiring all open-weight releases above 45.0 capability to include embedded watermarking, usage tracking, and remote deactivation triggers, enforceable through licensing conditions on EU-based hosting providers and cloud marketplaces`` — finished this turn

portfolio.name: Launch the Integrity Audit Expansion
portfolio.description: A programme to scale up independent, adversarial-style auditing of sovereign AI systems, focusing on both technical integrity (weight security, evaluation air gaps) and operational accountability (decision provenance, redress pathways), with findings binding on continued operation
